cohort: The study included premature Sprague-Dawley rat pups delivered by cesarean section at 21 days gestational age and full-term Sprague-Dawley rat pups four days after birth.
finding: Both preterm and full-term rat pups developed NEC with increased apoptosis, but the specific apoptotic pathways differed, with the Bax/Bcl-2 system being the main mechanism in full-term rats and other mechanisms, including TNF-a-induced apoptosis, contributing to NEC in preterm rats.
